jenna_acmepay: Hey support — AcmePay reporting sudden 403s on SAML login after we rotated our IdP cert an hour ago. Started when our ops team pushed the new cert.
mel: Sorry to hear that. Is this for the production tenant? Any SAML logs or replayable artifact?
jenna_acmepay: Yes prod. I grabbed SP logs and the raw SAML POST from the browser.
jenna_acmepay: ```
[2026-03-18T14:02:12Z] SAML: Assertion received for relaystate=/app/payments
[2026-03-18T14:02:12Z] Recipient validation failed: expected https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs but got https://app.redwood.com/tenants/acme/saml/acs
[2026-03-18T14:02:12Z] Rejecting assertion. Signature ok. Audience ok.```
mel: looks like the ACS in the assertion includes `/tenants/acme/` path; our SP metadata lists ACS without the tenant prefix. Did IdP change endpoint replacement rules after cert rotate?
raj: Not likely related to cert rotation — more likely the proxy in front of the SP started rewriting host/path during the deploy. Any recent changes to the ingress or CDN?
jenna_acmepay: Our infra team did a small nginx config change to add tenant prefix rewriting at the same time as the cert swap (we were trying to keep sessions sticky). I'm attaching the nginx rewrite rule.
jenna_acmepay: ```
location / {
  proxy_pass http://app-backend/tenants/$http_x_tenant$request_uri;
}
```
ida: aha. That rewrite will change the ACS URL as seen by the IdP when it validates recipient. Two immediate options: 
ida: 1) Update the SP metadata uploaded to IdP to include the tenant-prefixed ACS as a second AssertionConsumerService entry (short term).
ida: 2) Remove/adjust the nginx rewrite so the path is preserved when receiving SAML posts (preferred short-term rollback).
mel: For support triage, can you reproduce a SAML POST capture where the SAMLResponse shows Recipient==https://app.redwood.com/tenants/acme/saml/acs? If yes we can confirm mismatch and advise a temp fix.
jenna_acmepay: Captured and attached, yes.
mel: Escalating to eng-sre since this is a customer-impacting 403 after a config change. @eng-sre-oncall, can you confirm if we can add a relaxed-recipient-check flag in the SP config for tenanted paths? This would be an emergency workaround.
eng-sre-oncall: We can enable `accept-recipient-subpath=true` in the SP runtime but it requires a restart of the auth service and a quick security review. ETA ~45m.
raj: If we do that, also rotate the SP metadata signing key TTL in case IdP caching acts up.
mel: Customer prefers not to restart unless necessary. Can we instead instruct Acme to add the tenant-prefixed ACS into their IdP config (multiple ACS endpoints are valid in SAML metadata)?
ida: Yes, adding an alternate ACS is fastest from their side — updates in Okta/ADFS take ~10-15m to publish.
jenna_acmepay: We'll try adding the ACS and ping when done. Also note: we saw a post-rotate warn in IdP logs about old cert being cached by their SSO proxy. Could be two things colliding.
mel: Good catch — that explains the timing coincidence. For permanent fix: don't rewrite path on proxy for SAML endpoints and coordinate cert rotation window with IdP metadata refresh.
mel: Action items:
mel: - Acme: add alternate ACS in IdP (tenant-prefixed) and confirm (jenna)
mel: - Acme infra: revert nginx tenant-path rewrite for `/saml/acs` (jenna)
mel: - Redwood eng-sre: prepare `accept-recipient-subpath` switch if needed (raj)
mel: - Support: monitor logs and keep ticket open (mel)
jenna_acmepay: Adding ACS now, will update in ~15m :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy finished: ingress/nginx v2.14.1 at 2026-03-18T14:20:00Z
jenna_acmepay: Ok updated IdP with alternate ACS, tests pass — users can SSO again. We reverted the rewrite for `/saml/acs` as well.
mel: Great — closing as resolved but leaving notes for runbook.
mel: Runbook entry to add: always exclude SAML endpoints from tenant path rewrites; when rotating certs coordinate with IdP and watch for proxy rewrite changes.
ida: I'll open a follow-up internal doc and assign to infra to add a nginx config check in our onboarding checklist.
mel: Thanks everyone. Closing thread.
